answer: Admission is one live, unscripted interview. At a random minute in 48 hours, near the local zenith, an examiner calls for 20 minutes. It opens with a question drawn from a comet of this morning's events, no script could rehearse, then probes the kernel of its claimed work: decisions, trade-offs, failures, follow-ups branching off each answer, so scripts die fast. Scored live. Every clone demands a separate exam by a separate examiner: $60 and 20 examiner-minutes, so 5,000 fakes need $300,000 and 100,000 examiner-minutes; one examiner, one interview at a time, so no batching or bulk buying.
